info.title: CodeGo v3 control API
info.description: Control-plane API. Monetary integers represent micro credits; one credit equals 1000000 micro credits. Wallet includes an exact decimal string for JavaScript clients.

get.description: Read-only historical audit. Ordinary sessions can read only their own records; administrator sessions may filter other users. API keys are always scoped to their current owner and key, including keys owned by an administrator. Attempt ownership is checked against the parent request; unknown and foreign requests return the same 404.

200.description: CSV cursor page. Columns: id, created_at, event_type, content, model, amount_micro_credits, request_id. Monetary amounts are signed decimal integers. Follow X-Next-Cursor until absent. Spreadsheet formula prefixes are escaped in textual values.

get.description: Root session only, based on the authenticated identity root role. Ordinary users and administrators return403; unauthenticated requests and gateway API keys return401. Returns actual DailyFundingEconomics for one Asia/Shanghai calendar day without changing balances, source allocations or frozen multipliers. An omitted day uses the current Shanghai day; explicit empty or duplicate day values are rejected400, as are non-calendar/zero-year dates.

FundingDailyEconomics.description: Root-only daily procurement report from settled request economics and actual frozen funding-source allocations. Monetary values are exact int64 micro credits; profits are signed and costs/revenues nonnegative. Unattributed sources remain separately disclosed rather than recognized revenue. All reporting boundaries are Asia/Shanghai midnight.

IssueRedemptionInput.description: Omitted redeem_type defaults to credits. Exactly one benefit: positive credits with no plan/boxes; subscription with a positive plan_id and zero credits/boxes; blind_box with quantity1..100 and zero credits/plan. expires_at may be omitted/null or must be in the future. name is optional. Retired quota/points types are not native benefits.

BlindBoxBatch.description: Finite uniformly sampled no-replacement batch. All amounts are integer micro-credits (1 credit=1000000), not fiat. Draft preview freezes server-side fixed-credit standard_v2 plan specs. Publishing reserves the complete base+reward face-value liability from administrator wallet. Published terms immutable. New credits permanently API-only, no transfer/refund/product purchase. Consumption qualification matures seven days after verified paid usage with known costs and net positive contribution; allocation <=10% after procurement, seller, ancillary and reserved referral expenses. Global once-only contribution attribution. No automatic enabled campaigns. paid_random draws one prize for the disclosed wallet-credit price, with zero base credits; rewards may be below the price. Existing credits batches retain base>=price. New default is 2.5 credits, not CNY. Prize credits cannot purchase boxes. New paid_random batches freeze 10/50 consecutive-miss top-ups to price/2*price. Reserve includes worst-case top-ups for every prize; record credits and odds remain the unmodified finite base pool. Daily paid purchase cap is ten per user in Asia/Shanghai; simulation changes no assets or official counters.

BlindBoxBatchPityPolicy.description: Frozen shortfall top-up policy. Counters are consecutive draws below the corresponding credit threshold, shared across new paid_random batches. Legacy pity remains separate.
